'''Sapir''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] known to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its leaves were used to make the [[Sapir tea|sapir]] [[Tea/Legends|tea]], a hot, green-[[Color/Legends|colored]] beverage with a fragrant smell that was suitable for [[Human/Legends|Human]] consumption. A favorite of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], sapir tea was served in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SOTJ" />

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sapir was mentioned in [[Secrets of the Jedi (novel)|''Secrets of the Jedi'']], a young reader novel written by [[Jude Watson]] and published in [[2005]].
